scientific_scope: reused calibration screen; historically target-exposed; not fresh, not holdout, and not an unbiased generalization estimate

novelty_boundary.tested_hypothesis: Use strong NLM only in inference-visible flat regions while retaining the manual-safe h20 response around detected content edges and every 20-pixel fragment boundary
novelty_boundary.historical_audit: Global h>=30 and repeated NLM were rejected for structure collapse; no prior fixed edge-mask blend of safe and aggressive single-pass outputs was located
novelty_boundary.not_a_claim: This does not rehabilitate global h>=30 or multi-pass smoothing

fixed_pipeline.layout: bilateral directional scores -> solve_buddies(max_edges=96), strict upright permutation of all 576 input tiles
fixed_pipeline.postassembly_order: RGB seam offsets -> bounded luminance gains -> independently compute safe/aggressive single-pass NLM outputs -> fixed target-blind spatial blend

mask_algorithm.safe_source: colored NLM h20/hColor20 single-pass uint8 RGB
mask_algorithm.grid_protection: for coordinates 20,40,...,460 set rows and columns [coordinate-1:coordinate+1] true
mask_algorithm.soft_safe_weight: clip(cv2.GaussianBlur(float32 dilated mask, ksize=(0,0), sigmaX=1.0, sigmaY=1.0),0,1)

target_access_order: verify only input PNGs and exact selected roster
solve and audit the shared strict layout
freeze harmonized canvas, every independent NLM image, every mask and every final arm prediction
write and read back a content-addressed commitment with target-free safety diagnostics
only then decode primary target PNGs once

manual_review.compare: winner versus A and B after prediction commitment
fail_on: new smooth blob crossing a protected content edge or tile boundary
material loss of identifiable text, face, or object edge relative to A
halo or contour artifact caused by the soft mask

selection_rule: Among C,D,E passing every numeric and manual primary gate, select maximum mean RGB SSIM; break exact ties by lower aggressive_h, then lower threshold, then arm name. B is diagnostic and cannot win. Do not access confirmation if no candidate passes.
confirmation_gate: The unchanged primary winner must pass every identical numeric and manual gate on ranked calibration records 144:168.
forbidden: per-board, per-image-class, filename-dependent, or target-dependent arm selection
new mask threshold or arm after primary target access
tile substitution, rotation, resampling, spatial warp, or geometry change
changes to the existing production ZIP
